# Coached by Debs

> Premium 1-to-1 personal training and online coaching for anyone who wants to get fitter, healthier, and more confident. Based on the Isle of Man, serving clients in-person locally and online worldwide.

Coached by Debs is run by Debs, a certified personal trainer and coach with 5+ years of experience. Programmes are bespoke, evidence-based, and designed to fit real life — no extreme diets or unsustainable routines.

## Services

- [1-to-1 Personal Training](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/personal-training): In-studio and outdoor personal training — Single Session, 8-Session Transformation, and 12-Week Premium Coaching.
- [Online Coaching](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/online-coaching): Remote coaching in Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers with training plans, nutrition guidance, and weekly accountability.
- [Pricing](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/pricing): Full package and pricing comparison across personal training and online coaching.
- [Upcoming Events](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/events): Live masterclasses, challenges, and retreats, in person and online.
- [Client Results](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/results): Testimonials and a transformation photo gallery from real clients.
- [About Debs](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/about): Debs' background, credentials, and coaching philosophy.
- [FAQ](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/faq): Answers to common questions about training, nutrition, and booking.
- [Contact & Booking](https://www.coachedbydebs.com/contact): Booking form, free consultation requests, and contact details.
